_description: A prolate spheroid, 1 m long and 0.25 m across (selftest/assets/spheroid: OpenFOAM v2606's searchableSphere with three radii), its centre 0.4 m over a ground that moves with the air, in a 20 m/s stream of air at nu 1.5e-5 m^2/s: Re 1.33e6 on its length. simpleFoam with k-omega SST and Spalding's wall function, 300 iterations. Measured in P0 (2026-10-23, 8 ranks): 41 574 cells after snappyHexMesh, 0 faces in error against ESI's meshQualityDict, layers on 100% of the body, the drag area settled to 2e-5 of itself by iteration 134 (CdA 0.00443 m^2 on this mesh), y+ at most 300 on all of the body. Its ladder (P6, ratio 1.5) converges monotonically to 0.00364 m^2 on the finest of three meshes, GCI 15.7%. The domain meets Franke et al. 2007 with the sides the nearest (5.48 H against 5 H). Chosen over P0's ground-mounted cube, which is unsteady in steady RANS on the finer meshes.

_claims.statement: The spheroid's drag area at 20 m/s is at most 0.0044 m^2

_notes._units: SI throughout: metres, m/s, m^2/s, seconds. The drag area CdA is in m^2: forceCoeffs with Aref 1 writes it as its Cd column.
_notes._paths: aero_case resolves against the PROJECT ROOT (ctx.root). Each gate copies the case's 0/, constant/ (not constant/polyMesh or triSurface) and system/ under its out directory, writes the pack's own dictionaries into the copy, and runs there; the project's directory is never written.
_notes.aero_case: the OpenFOAM case: system/controlDict (no functions), fvSchemes, fvSolution, blockMeshDict (one axis-aligned box), snappyHexMeshDict; constant/transportProperties and turbulenceProperties (RAS kOmegaSST); 0/U, p, k, omega, nut. The air enters along +x through the box's low-x side.
_notes.aero_body_group: the patch group snappyHexMesh puts the body's patches in (patchInfo inGroups): the drag is summed over it.
_notes.aero_geometry: (not used here) the surface file a case's snappyHexMeshDict names, when the body is one: a path against the project root, or $FOAM_TUTORIALS/... in the OpenFOAM install. Never committed to a project when its licence forbids it.
_notes.aero_geometry_sha256: (not used here) the sha256 of aero_geometry: the gates run the body they were told, by content.
_notes.aero_u_inf_m_s: the air's speed far from the body, m/s: the inlet's, and the speed every coefficient is made dimensionless by.
_notes.aero_ref_length_m: the body's reference length, m: the Reynolds number's length.
_notes.aero_sound_speed_m_s: the speed of sound in the air, m/s: the Mach number's.
_notes.aero_ranks: MPI ranks for each parallel run (pack default 8). 4 here: the spheroid's 41 574 cells give each rank about 10 000.
_notes.aero_max_global_cells: the cell cap snappyHexMesh may refine to (pack default 2e7, ten times the motorBike tutorial's). A mesh that reaches it fails aero.mesh_quality.
_notes.aero_iter_unc_max_pct: the largest iterative uncertainty U_I = (max - min) / 2 of the drag area over the last window, in percent of its mean (pack default 1, the author's choice D3).
_notes.aero_timeout_s: seconds each OpenFOAM tool may run before it is killed with every rank and the gate skips (pack default 3600).
_notes.aero_ladder_ratio: the mesh ladder's ratio per level on every block direction (pack default 1.5): blocks (28 12 8), (42 18 12), (63 27 18); measured 41 574, 132 094 and 386 302 cells on 4 ranks, effective ratios 1.470 and 1.430.
_notes.aero_gci_max_pct: the largest GCI of the finest mesh aero.mesh_independence accepts, in percent: 20 for this spheroid, whose observed order 2.71 is past the formal 2 + 0.05, so its band is taken at p = 2 with Fs 3: 15.67%, and the 1.125 times larger body of bigger_body (which this guard must pass for that control to reach aero.drag_area) 18.28%. The motorBike demo states 5 (D3). Rejected: 5 (both ladders fail it, and no control could reach aero.drag_area); 25 (a band that wide on the baseline is a margin nothing measured asks for).
_notes.aero_rho_kg_m3: ISA sea-level air, for the drag force aero.drag_area reports beside the drag area (not judged).
_notes._claims: the claim the baseline is calibrated against: the drag area, tagged drag-area, which aero.drag_area alone covers and reads the limit of. 0.0044 m^2: measured (P6), the top of the baseline's band is 0.00421412 m^2 (4.4% under it) and bigger_body's 0.00529625 m^2 (1.204 times it). Rejected: P3's placeholder 0.0042 (under the baseline's own top: the known-good control would fail).
